sentences.text: Doreen Abbott (S2) is the person being assessed; Gareth Lloyd (S1) is the care assessor; Karen Wells (S3) is the daughter.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she lost her husband, Ron, on May 9th after 52 years of marriage.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she cannot keep up gardening, which she attributed to her late husband Ron.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she cannot get into the bath and now performs a strip wash at the sink.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she sometimes goes up the stairs on her bottom.
Karen Wells (S3) stated Doreen Abbott (S2) nearly fell on the landing in October.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she bruised her arm after the fall but did not go to the hospital.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she eats a bit of soup and a sandwich, noting she is not one for cooking for one, while Karen Wells (S3) brings food.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she is eating all right because Karen Wells (S3) brings food.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she feels lonely, describing days as 'Long. Quiet. Nobody to talk to.'
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated, 'I'd be better off dead, love.'
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she does not know if she has thought about ending her life.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated that if she were put in a home, she would stop eating.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she wants to stay at home with Ron's things and will only eat as long as she is there.

Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she had been saving her tablets, not taking them, and keeping them.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she had been saving approximately 40 tablets since the summer.
Karen Wells (S3) stated she found the tablets on Sunday, hidden in Doreen Abbott's (S2) bedside drawer in an envelope under her handkerchiefs, and took them home in her bag.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated there were no other tablets saved elsewhere in the house.
Doreen Abbott (S2) stated she has her pension and a council benefit from Ron, and that Karen Wells (S3) handles bills on the computer.
Karen Wells (S3) stated they sorted the bank account after Ron's funeral and that Doreen Abbott (S2) is fine for money.
